svg.title: Finally buckle is the secured product vault(wing, ql) wire(p, l) with toll L−2. Vault and its overlap identities preserve securedness. Thus one actual carried fine difference has exponential coefficient bound CL−3. Its fine curl sums four directions and fixed two-form incidence signs, costing at most 4|Faces2|CL−3; this constant uses only orientation counts and introduces no residue factor. Multiplying by the bounded coarse metric and applying the coarse-column exterior right lift retains the prefactor, so sale costs C′L−3 per residue. Its Gram sum has L4 residues and therefore costs C′′L4(L−3)2 = C′′L−2. This is the precise inverse-square scale used in the positive three-form absorption. The fine difference is taken before the lift and norm estimate; applying an ordinary unweighted bound before the fine difference would lose this power. Readout preserves this order and the actual carried stencil, so no lost block power is replaced by an unproved estimate.
